Avery: Heads-up — Leadership Forum next Wed 11:00am PT (hybrid). Planning a ~45m sync + 15m open Q&A. Drop any agenda items here or in the form below.
CalendarBot: Event created — https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/leadership-forum-1718765432 (meeting room + dial-in).
Maya: Can we slot a 5-min product highlight for the new routing policy rollout? I have a short demo.
Jorge: +1 to the rollout callout. Also want to include a 2-slide incident summary from last week (what happened and mitigation). Will keep to 3 min.
Sam: We'll collect questions beforehand — pls use this form so we can triage: https://forms.redwood.ai/lead-forum-qa (deadline Tue 5pm PT).
Olivia: I’ll set up recording + captions. Recording link will be posted to #all-hands afterward and added to the handbook.
Maya: Draft agenda (quick snippet):
```
1) Exec update (Avery) — 10m
2) Product highlight: Smart routing (Maya) — 5m
3) Dedicated & Private capacity update (Jorge) — 7m
4) Reliability recap & incident summary (Jorge) — 3m
5) Customer wins + metrics (Sam) — 5m
6) Ops & rollout playbook (Maya) — 5m
7) Q&A — 15m
```
Avery: Looks good. Keep slides to <6 slides per presenter. If you need any special AV (screen share + video), ping Olivia.
Jorge: Will attach a one-slide timeline + RCA. Any objections to calling out the mitigation timeline publicly?
Sam: No objections from People Ops — transparency is fine. We'll coordinate wording if there are PII/security details.
Olivia: FYI — if you want captions, upload slides by Tue noon so I can add speaker names for auto-captions.
Maya: Example Qs to seed the form: "How will routing affect latency for short sequences?" and "Will model fallbacks change for Dedicated customers?"
Avery: Please flag any high-sensitivity items (legal/privacy) when submitting so we can handle offline.
Sam: Reminder — submit talk decks & the QA form by Tue 5pm PT. I’ll collate and share a final agenda Wed morning.
Olivia: Noted — will post recording + condensed takeaways in this thread within 24h after the forum.
Avery: Thanks team — excited to share the routing demo and the new observability dashboards. :rocket:
